title: Trusting God's Timing | What To Do While You're Waiting On God
description:
Trusting God's timing while you're waiting on God and heaven feels quiet.

David asked how long. Jesus waited two days before going to Lazarus. What the Bible says about delay, and how to wait with courage instead of running ahead.

"Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD." Psalm 27:14 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Psalm 13:1-2, John 11:5-6, Habakkuk 2:3, Isaiah 30:18, Psalm 27:14, Psalm 37:7, Psalm 130:5-6, Lamentations 3:25-26, Psalm 40:1-2.
